result.title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
result.summary: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究超高分辨率遥感问答中，将高分辨率裁剪块编码为少量连续 visual latent memory token（冻结主干、丢弃裁剪 token）能否保留细粒度局部证据，并通过替换他图/他区域 memory、清零与恢复原裁剪的对照实验检验预测对 latent 内容的依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 LVR 关注的两点：压缩 latent 状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节，以及答案是否真正使用 latent 内容——其「替换来源」因果对照可供核查 latent 相似度与内容依赖诊断的设计，同时把证据可用性与区域选择解耦，可能有助于区分 LOOK 的贡献。
